judged_text: `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` calls String#scrub, which does not exist on the Ruby this app runs (the Gemfile states the project targets 1.9; String#scrub shipped in Ruby 2.1), so poll_feed raises NoMethodError on every execution. With feed_polling_enabled, the hourly job crashes before importing anything, so feed-based embedding never imports a single item. Additionally the loop has no per-item rescue, so even on a Ruby with scrub, one item with nil content (plain RSS 2.0 description-only feeds) or nil title aborts all remaining items for that run, every run.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, the new code does `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`. If `i.content` is `nil` (common for RSS feeds that only provide `description`), this will raise `NoMethodError` (`nil.scrub`) and abort the run. Also, `String#scrub` is not available on older Rubies (e.g., 1.9/2.0), and the diff’s Gemfile comments indicate the app may target Ruby 1.9, in which case this line would crash every execution when feed polling is enabled.
